summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with a press release dated September 8, 2026, announcing that it will release an initial Mineral Resource estimate for the Apollo deposit at its Guayabales Project in Colombia after market close that day. A webcast and conference call are scheduled for September 9, 2026, to discuss the resource and planned work programs. This is a routine operational update for a mining exploration company, not a special-situation corporate event. No terms, transactions, or strategic actions are involved. The filing contains no deal terms or unusual corporate activity.
